title: SubmissionDespatchedPayload
description: Payload of the SubmissionDespatched event (catalogued in model/architecture/events.yaml, INV-NOTE-3 §19.8; class: domain). Authored by INV-T-2854 (T10). Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

payloadSha256.description: SHA-256 of the despatched payload bytes (payload-svc's PayloadReady).

aggregateId.description: The identifier of the aggregate this document was recorded from: the aggregateId of the AggregateReady event, set only for a document recorded from an aggregate and absent on every other document; carried unchanged by CanonicalVersionCreated, PayloadReady and SubmissionDespatched so that aggregation-svc can mark the aggregate transmitted (INV-REQ-439). Optional so an older consumer validates.
